## Hypothesis

We aim to improve edge capture on J's winner days by tightening exits (earlier TP1, wider stop) and adding a volume filter to avoid low-quality trades. The hypothesis is that ITM-2 strikes combined with a 150% TP1 and 35% stop will capture more winner-day gamma while the volume filter reduces loser-day false triggers.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger from shotgun scalper Stage 2 (parent strategy) – assumes same trigger logic as baseline (e.g., VWAP continuation or level rejection).  
**Exit:**  
- TP1 at +150% premium (sell 2/3 position)  
- Catastrophe stop at -35% premium  
- Time stop at 15 minutes  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +50% premium, trails 15% off HWM  
**Contract:** ITM-2 puts (strike_offset=2)  
**Filter:** vol_ratio_threshold >= 1.0 (current volume >= 20-bar average volume)
